input.text: The driver says they are safe and the Bentley is parked at a motorway service-area car park, heading north to Hamburg, engine off. They will not hand it over until Bahn says who is collecting. They have not given the service-area name yet and will send it with a live pin.
We don't know exactly where the car is. The last app position is 4 hours old (07:00 Berlin time, about 233 km from Hamburg), from before the stop. The driver hasn't sent a location pin yet.

The promised delivery window is today 12:00–16:00 Hamburg time. With the car stopped and no recovery plan, it will very likely be missed. The customer was told at 10:49 Berlin time that we will update the estimate once the recovery plan is confirmed.
The customer, Marvellin Motorhandel, asked us to keep the car stopped. They are checking with their service contact whether it needs roadside help or collection. No decision from them yet.
